rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's seventeen builder trees go (canary date palms, ficus and corals along the back fences, fan and queen palms and a coral 3-4.6 m from the house fronts, others in the yards); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two or three houses: by the grill, the two arbors, and in two back yards 8-12 m from the houses.

trees.why: the back yard with the kettle grill and the potted plants: a jacaranda over the cook
the west yard with the garden arbor (1.4 m off): a jacaranda beside it
the north-west yard with the arbor and the adirondack chair: a coral tree to sit under
the south back lot line, 12 m from the houses: a coral tree between two yards
the north back yard, 7.7 m from the house: the yard's tree
